children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on Sherwin-Williams's stock with a price target of $390.00.
The price target implies an upside of 19.6% from the Oct 27 close of $326.01.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Sherwin-Williams reported a 7.9% increase in sales to $6.86 billion, exceeding expectations and demonstrating growth in all three business segments. This robust performance indicates a resilient demand for their products, reinforcing investor confidence.

: Despite a slight decline in gross margin, the company has a history of strong pricing power and expects to recover margins as raw material costs stabilize. This potential for margin recovery, coupled with a long history of steady EBITDA growth, supports the Buy rating.
